cards.line: Tommy Reyes passed in the night. 81. he wound the church clock every sunday for twenty years. who winds it now.
cards.try: Tommy Reyes passed last night. 81. wound the church clock every sunday for twenty years. who's gonna wind it now

cards.line: I got him! Did you see that?
cards.try: I fucking got him! Did you see that?!

cards.line: We didn't run. We relocated. Loudly.
cards.try: We didn't run, we got the fuck out. There's a difference.

cards.line: RUIZ. I'm going to find RUIZ.
cards.try: Ruiz did this. I'm gonna find that motherfucker and every one of his boys.

cards.in_the_file: Two tours, one pension. The pension died first. Where do you want me?
cards.line: Two tours, one pension. The pension died first. Where do you want me?
cards.try: Two tours and a pension, and the fucking pension died first. Point me where you want me.

cards.mouth: A JOB GIVER AT THE BOARD
cards.in_the_file: The motel by the freeway was ours, beds for the soup line. A crew took it and charges at the door. Clear them out, and {pay} batteries.
cards.line: The motel by the freeway was ours, beds for the soup line. A crew took it and charges at the door. Clear them out, and 80 batteries.
cards.try: That motel by the freeway was ours. Beds for the soup line. A crew took it, and now the hungry pay at the door. Clear them out and I'll give you 80 batteries, everything the kitchen saved.

cards.in_the_file: Ay, mijo. My tooth. Three weeks. THE TOOTH has the only kit that works and his men sit at the town gates taking batteries for him. He puts his flyers up by the clinics.
cards.line: Ay, mijo. My tooth. Three weeks. THE TOOTH has the only kit that works and his men sit at the town gates taking batteries for him. He puts his flyers up by the clinics.
cards.try: My tooth. Three weeks, and it's killing me. THE TOOTH has the only kit that works, and his men sit at the town gates taking batteries off everybody. Find that son of a bitch. His flyers are up by the clinics.

cards.in_the_file: they're coming up the ladder. i heard two shots.
cards.line: they're coming up the ladder. i heard two shots.
cards.try: They're coming up the fucking ladder. I heard two shots. Oh shit. Oh shit.

cards.mouth: YOUR MAN, BEFORE A FIGHT WITH ANIMALS
cards.in_the_file: They smell the food in our cart{boss}, and they want it.
cards.line: They smell the food in our cart, boss, and they want it.
cards.try: They smell the food in our cart, boss, and those hungry fuckers want it.

cards.mouth: A ROAD STOP: WHAT COMES BACK
cards.who: A GIRL IN A STORM DRAIN
cards.in_the_file: She runs home without saying gracias. Later the whole town knows who did it.
cards.line: She runs home without saying gracias. Later the whole town knows who did it.
cards.try: (a neighbour, leaning on her fence) That little girl ran home without even saying thanks. What, you want a fucking parade? Relax. The whole town already knows it was you who dug her out.

cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.in_the_file: In front of both families. They'll vote like it's a fair thing and go home knowing exactly what they voted for.
cards.line: In front of both families. They'll vote like it's a fair thing and go home knowing exactly what they voted for.
cards.try: In front of both families. They'll vote like it's fair, and every one of them goes home knowing exactly what the fuck they voted for.
